name: Hamza Islah
title: PhD candidate in constraint programming and machine learning
affiliation: Ai movement, Mohammed VI Polytechnic University
bio: I work at the interface between constraint programming and machine learning. My question is a practical one: how far can a learned model go in helping people build, diagnose and solve constraint models, from suggesting the next query in constraint acquisition to predicting whether an instance is satisfiable before a solver spends hours on it.
research_interests: Integration of machine learning and constraint programming to build systems that help with constraint problem modeling
Predicting the unsatisfiability of constraint problems
Using machine learning to improve constraint satisfaction problem solving
